newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron to roll out new switching product.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron to roll out new switching product.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc executives said the company will be rolling out a new ethernet/fast ethernet switching product Monday.

The executives declined to provide details but cited trade press reports in two publications, Network World and ComputerWorld, as being generally accurate in describing the new product as having room for up to 120 ethernet switchboards and being priced at less than $330 per port.

Michael Skubisz, director of product marketing at Cabletron Systems Inc, said that while many of the company's network products have been targeted at the high end, it expects to see "a stratification in the market" and more products targeted at midrange and low-end users.

Steve Gray, the company's newly-named director of worldwide marketing and communications, said after a presentation to investors at a Robertson Stephens technology conference here that the product introduction on Monday addresses a product area demanded by customers.
"Cabletron is going through a maturing process," he said in the presentation, noting it had made five acquisitions in the last 12 months after not having completed any for some time before that.
The executives declined to comment on earnings estimates, noting the company's financial year closes at the end of this week.

Robertson Stephens analyst Paul Johnson said he is confident the company is on track to meet expectations. Johnson's recent estimates are for Cabletron to produce earnings per share of $0.48 in its fourth fiscal quarter and $1.78 for the fiscal year to the end of February. ((sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
